title: MCP++ A2A TaskMetadata@1
description: Normalized MCP++ extension metadata carried on an A2A Task (or primary Artifact) under the execution extension. Keys are short suffixes; wire form MAY expand each to https://mcplusplus.io/extensions/execution/v1/<suffix>. Does not redefine A2A TaskState. Interface: A2AExtensionSchema@1. Normative prose: a2a-extension.md §4.3, §6.2–§6.11.
$comment: Schema marker: mcp++/a2a/task-metadata@1. Structural schema only (ADR-0003); portable success still requires receipt_cid per terminal-evidence schema.

schema.description: Closed schema marker for normalized Task extension metadata.

envelope_cid.description: CID of ExecutionEnvelope@1 when an envelope has been minted.

receipt_cid.description: CID of ExecutionReceipt@1. Required for portable cross-trust success.

event_cid.description: Event DAG node linking envelope/result/receipt or latest status-related node.

output_cid.description: Primary output CID aligning with ExecutionResult@1.output_cids / primary_output_cid.

method.description: Method / skill operation name within the interface.

state_ref_cids.description: StateRef@1 CIDs for shared MCP++ state under the task context.

profiles.description: Profile letters claimed for this task under the extension. Must be a subset of the agent-advertised profiles.

profile.description: Single profile letter claimed for this request (alternative to profiles[]).

required_abilities.description: UCAN abilities still needed when Task is auth-required.

audience.description: Expected audience DID for authority proofs.
